Description: Baseline platform: sign-in, roles, /health, /version and log masking.

Summary: Onboard a supplier with a bank account that a second person verifies
Description: Only PROCUREMENT creates suppliers. Account 9-18 digits; IFSC ^[A-Z]{4}0[A-Z0-9]{6}$; invalid input returns 422. Supplier is pending until a FINANCE_APPROVER verifies the account. The person who added the account cannot verify it (SELF_VERIFICATION_NOT_ALLOWED).

Summary: Show bank account numbers masked everywhere
Description: UI and API show only the last four digits. Logs replace any 9-18 digit number with **** last4.

Summary: Schedule and release supplier payments with separation of duties
Description: Only FINANCE_OPS schedules; only active suppliers. Amount positive with at most two decimals; date today or later. Destination account fixed at creation. Only FINANCE_APPROVER releases; not the scheduler (SELF_RELEASE_NOT_ALLOWED); released once.

Summary: Record an audit trail of every change
Description: Onboarding, verification, scheduling and release write audit events with actor. No full account numbers in details. AUDITOR and FINANCE_APPROVER can read; others 403.

Summary: Let Procurement change a supplier's bank account
Description: 1. Procurement can submit a new bank account for an active supplier. 2. The new account must be approved by a Finance Approver before it becomes active. 3. The new account number is masked in the UI and API. 4. The change is recorded in the audit trail.
